motivation: The completed historical 768-token output-cache SERSEM weighting study did not beat its z-sigmoid baseline, but the public LUMIA hidden-state signal family and 8192-token input protocol remain untested.

cohort.selection: deterministic seed 20260909, balanced by language x membership

activation_extraction.author_literal_character_weights: generate_char_weight_mask(text) without language, matching current released caller
activation_extraction.helper_language_aware_character_weights: secondary mechanism branch with explicit known language

pooling.author_literal_weighted: weighted mean using caller-literal token weights
pooling.helper_language_aware_weighted: weighted mean using language-aware helper token weights

feature_sets.mean_only: mean activation only; hidden-state baseline ablation
feature_sets.lumia_caller_literal: concatenate mean and caller-literal weighted activation
feature_sets.lumia_helper_language_aware: concatenate mean and helper-language-aware weighted activation

activation_extraction.failure_policy: fail closed on model/tokenization/shape failures; do not zero-fill failed samples for scientific evaluation

evaluation.outer_split: 5-fold stratified by language x label; every row scored exactly once OOF
evaluation.layer_selection: top 5 by inner selection AUC only
evaluation.outer_holdout_use: score only; never used for probe weights, early stopping, or layer selection

scale_to_2000_or_more_if_any: caller-literal top5 ensemble OOF AUC >= same-input zsigmoid AUC + 0.015
caller-literal top5 ensemble TPR@1% FPR >= same-input zsigmoid + 0.01 absolute
caller-literal top5 ensemble adds >= 10 unique conservative true positives at 1% FPR
helper-language-aware branch shows a reproducible language-specific gain that survives outer OOF and paired bootstrap
do_not_scale_if: all hidden-state variants are near random or clearly dominated by same-input output baselines
apparent improvement comes only from inner layer-selection metrics rather than outer OOF

resource_contract.preferred_initial_accelerator: single Kaggle T4 unless admission/runtime pilot shows it is insufficient

scientific_boundary: Activation extraction and probe architecture follow the released mechanism; outer OOF is intentionally stricter than the author runner because the author internal test split is used for layer selection and is therefore not an unbiased final performance estimate.
